create_encoding_layer: create an Encoding layer with specified channels and num_codes for learnable residual encoding
run_encoding_forward: run the Encoding forward pass on a 4D tensor of shape batch_size, channels, height, width
test_scaled_l2: test the scaled_l2 static method to compute scaled L2 distances between features and codewords
test_aggregate: test the aggregate static method to compute encoded features from assignment weights and codewords
review_encoding_class: review the Encoding class architecture including codewords, scale parameters, and forward pass logic
